# Headphone University

> The internet's #1 comprehensive resource for headphone buying guides, reviews, and product comparisons across all types and use cases.

Headphone University provides expert guidance on selecting headphones for various needs including gaming, sports, budget options, and specialized uses like bone conduction technology. The site features detailed product comparisons, buying guides, and troubleshooting articles covering major brands like Apple AirPods, Beyerdynamic, Razer, and AfterShokz.
